summary: Frontend-only testing of modernized admin backoffice UI redesign. All 8 admin tabs working correctly with modern SaaS-style layout. Login via bypass (admin@srdfsjl.pt / admin123) works. Dashboard shows 4 stat cards with icons, recent messages, and recent events with 'Ver todas/Ver todos' navigation links. All CRUD operations, toast notifications, hover-reveal actions, and filter buttons working as expected.

minor.issue: Returns 404 - Dataverse not configured (expected behavior per requirements)

critical_code_review_comments: Modern SaaS-style UI with dark green gradient sidebar implemented correctly
All 8 tabs accessible via sidebar navigation: Dashboard, Homepage, Eventos, Servicos, Cronologia, Mensagens, Socios, Definicoes
Dashboard shows 4 stat cards with icons (Eventos Futuros, Mensagens, Socios Pendentes, Servicos)
Recent messages and upcoming events sections with 'Ver todas/Ver todos' clickable links that navigate to respective tabs
Toast notifications appear correctly on save/delete actions (Homepage guardada!, Criado com sucesso!, Definicoes guardadas!)
Hover-reveal action buttons working on Events (edit/delete), Services (edit/delete), Timeline (edit/delete)
Messages tab has filter buttons (Todas, Nao lidas, Respondidas) and action buttons (mark read, reply, email, delete)
Members tab has Dataverse view (with config warning) and Inscricoes view with approve/reject hover actions
Modern rounded inputs with focus states and proper styling
All data-testid attributes present for testing
